constraints.impact: Checking every pair inside every query is O(n · q) ≈ 10¹⁰ iterations: far too slow. Build one array in O(n), then answer each query in O(1).

constraints.meaning: All numbers are positive; only even or odd matters.
constraints.impact: nums[i] % 2 is 0 or 1 with no negative remainders. The count of bad pairs is at most n − 1 < 10⁵: int is enough.

constraints.meaning: Every query is a valid range; from = to is allowed.
constraints.impact: A range of one number has no pairs, so it is special: pre[to] − pre[from] = 0 gives true by itself.

bruteForce.summary: for every query, walk the pairs nums[from..to] and stop at the first pair with the same parity. A long query walks up to n pairs: O(n · q) in total.
